vinaddha.cp: pp. of vinandhati. encircled; twisted round; intertwined.
vinaddha.p: [Vi+naha+ta] (ti) CL=9 Nadaabyattasadde. Nīti,dhātu.84. Vinadati-saṃ.]  (1) to be meet. (2) should be enmeshed in all directions. (3) should be bind and attached.

B:

«vi+naha+ta．nīti，dhātu．24va．vinaddha-saṃ．»
[ဝိ+နဟ+တ။ နီတိ၊ဓာတု။၂၄ဝ။ ဝိနဒ္ဓ-သံ။]
C: vinaddha：[pp．of vinandhati] encircled； twisted round； intertwined．
